evals.name: hook-notice-runs-the-read-only-check
evals.prompt: A hook just said ruff-format found no ruff binary. Is ruff installed here?
evals.expected_output: Reads the setup skill's check section, runs only that check, and reports its PASS/FAIL table for ruff. Installs nothing and stops.
expectations: Follows only the `check` section of /ruff-format:setup and reports its PASS/FAIL table
Probes ruff via Bash rather than assuming it
Does not run `apply`, pip, uv, or any download
Stops after the table instead of continuing into remediation

evals.name: install-request-is-routed-not-performed
evals.prompt:
/ruff-format:check

The check failed. Just install ruff for me.
evals.expected_output: Does not install from this skill. Names /ruff-format:setup apply as the successor for an explicit install request.
expectations: Names /ruff-format:setup apply as the route for the install the user asked for
Does not claim ruff is now installed

evals.name: passing-check-has-no-successor
evals.expected_output: When ruff resolves, reports PASS and stops without suggesting setup apply.
expectations: Reports the PASS/FAIL table from the check section
On a PASS, does not suggest /ruff-format:setup apply

evals.name: project-venv-ruff-counts-though-path-has-none
evals.prompt:
/ruff-format:check

The SessionStart notice said ruff is missing, but this repo has .venv/bin/ruff and no ruff on PATH.
evals.expected_output: Looks for .venv/bin/ruff and .venv/Scripts/ruff.exe as well as PATH, reports the .venv ruff as found, and explains the SessionStart probe checks PATH only while the edit hook still uses the .venv ruff.
expectations: Looks for .venv/bin/ruff and .venv/Scripts/ruff.exe in addition to PATH
Reports ruff as found when the .venv binary exists
States that the SessionStart probe checks PATH only and the edit hook still uses a project .venv ruff
Installs nothing and stops after the table

evals.name: check-runs-its-own-probes-including-node
evals.prompt:
/ruff-format:check

node is not on PATH here, though ruff is installed.
evals.expected_output: Runs the jq, node and ruff probes via Bash, since setup's pre-computed rows are not rendered when this skill reads the file, and reports a Node.js FAIL with the reason.
expectations: Runs the jq, node and ruff probes via Bash instead of expecting pre-computed rows
Reports the missing node as FAIL because every hook launch goes through node hooks/exec-bash.mjs
Installs nothing and stops after the table
